newsitem.title: USA: U.S. barge rates-Quoted at steady to higher levels.
newsitem.headline: U.S. barge rates-Quoted at steady to higher levels.

text.p: U.S. barge rates remained quoted at mostly steady to higher levels in the nearby positions Friday on the St. Louis Merchants Exchange call session.
No barges traded, the same as Thursday.
- One barges, Mid-Mississippi River, next week, bid 115 percent, unchanged from Thursday, similar, no offer.
- One barge, Peoria, Illinois River, on station, no bid, offer 107-1/2 percent, up 2-1/2 percentage points from Thursday.
- Four barges, Illinois, one each week of July, bid 105 percent, up five percentage points from Thursday, offer 110 percent, unchanged from Thursday.
